gaps.gap: Edge classes (artifact / alternative / closure) live only in the author's notes; Plane's blocked_by has one meaning. Carried in the issue description and relation extras; artifact means met when the target has started (not only completed), alternative means met another way

held records a current gate on work that has not started; mapping it to a State 'Held' in group unstarted loses that it is a gate (not a readiness verdict), and Plane groups cannot distinguish held from todo by group alone

The tickets carry no per-ticket dates; created_at/updated_at are all as_of, so Plane's default order (-created_at, issue.py:178) ties on everything and falls back to sequence_id — real recency is lost
No priorities are assigned (priority_text absent), so every issue converts priority=none and Plane's order reduces to created_at then sequence_id
External needs have no Plane record; carried in external_needs, unmet unless the record shows state (none does)
The 11 not_edges (rejected needs, e.g. the A4-VERIFY/RUN-001 false cycle) are not convertible; their content — why a plain needs graph is wrong — is only in this gap
